decision: Freeze the measured coordinate architecture now and stop treating every ring-sector intersection as an atom. Atomic identity will be assigned to stable structural coordinates/units, while compound fields are represented compositionally.

bridge.rule: No outer ray is extended into the central rose unless an observed boundary relation supports it.

atomicModelCandidate.principle: Use factorized coordinates rather than target-fitted raster cells.
atomicModelCandidate.important: 72 + 22 + 4 must not be interpreted as a final AK count yet; the three sets play different semantic/topological roles.
atomicModelCandidate.compoundFieldRule: An outer field is an ordered tuple (sector, radial-band-state, relations), not necessarily a unique primitive atom.
atomicModelCandidate.glyphRule: Glyphs may be paths over atomic/coordinate nodes and compound fields; bitmap occupancy is a projection.
